blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu – Cebuana actress Ellen Adarna had a message for Dumanjuganons during the town’s Bisnok Festival showdown, to never be afraid to approach their public officials. Adarna was joined onstage by fellow Cebu celebrities Paul Jake Castillo and his wife Kaye Abad in Dumanjug, Cebu on Saturday, October 3. She shared her personal experience meeting Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro, as the Provincial Governor joined the festive celebration, whom she described as the “most humble” politician she has ever met.
